# drawbridge — general-purpose AI chatbots
#
# The web side of the `chatbots` option: blocked while it is off, and every entry
# repeated in that option's allowed_domains so switching it on brings them back
# (policytool.py sign refuses when the two disagree).
#
# The line is the long conversation, not AI as such. These are the services where
# a chat with memory goes on for weeks. Help bots on shops and assistants
# embedded in work tools are deliberately absent, and so are the parent domains:
# gemini.google.com and copilot.microsoft.com are their own hosts, so google.com,
# microsoft365.com and Office on the web keep working at the DNS layer.
#
# Search is handled in herald rather than here, because DNS can only refuse a
# whole host and www.google.com also serves reCAPTCHA to half the web. From
# 2026-11 the same switch, while off, has herald refuse Google Search (Gemini is
# built into it) and Copilot in Bing by URL, and send DuckDuckGo to
# noai.duckduckgo.com — see the chatbots fragment in policy.json.
#
# Every host was resolved and loaded on 2026-10-18 and answers with its chatbot.
# Grok is not here: it is on ai-companions.txt, always blocked.

chatgpt.com
chat.openai.com
claude.ai
gemini.google.com
bard.google.com
copilot.microsoft.com
copilot.cloud.microsoft
m365copilot.com
perplexity.ai
